scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present --filter=!@workspace/mobile run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.validate:frontend: pnpm run audit:frontend:typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/frontend test && pnpm --filter @workspace/frontend build
scripts.validate:production: pnpm run validate:api && pnpm run validate:frontend
